publishing_hold: Owner requested preparation only while development continues. Do not publish, schedule, deploy or activate recurring execution until the owner resumes publishing.
schedule_basis: The numbered days and KST times below are legacy draft slots, not a booked schedule. Select four posts per week after publishing resumes.
default_cadence: Initial experiment after publishing resumes: four original posts per week, normally no more than one per day. Two character/mood posts, one real development post, one relevant Base/community post. Compare 10:00 and 22:00 KST; replace irrelevant drafts with verified event posts.
publisher_plan: Prepare only now. After the owner resumes publishing, use the logged-in SOULI X browser, verify each published URL and record the result. Recurring execution is not configured.

owner_decisions.game_entry: Design the basic game so holding 1 SOULI is enough to participate. Verify the full production entry flow before claiming it is live.
owner_decisions.launch_sequence: SOULI sale, then use sale proceeds to seed LP, then open Uniswap trading on Base. The LP percentage, pair, timing and management terms are not yet finalized.
owner_decisions.audience: Start with a small committed holder and onchain-art community; mass gaming adoption is not a launch prerequisite.
owner_decisions.ambition: Work toward a $500M valuation as an aspirational target. Distinguish circulating market cap from FDV; never present the target as a return promise.

profile.bio: Onchain pixel souls on Base. Building a little world you can join with 1 SOULI.
profile.pinned_post:
SOULI is building a little world on Base.

Our design: 1 SOULI is enough to join.
Our launch plan: SOULI sale -> liquidity -> Uniswap trading.

Original pixel souls. A small community with a big ambition.

Game and launch details are in development.
profile.website_condition: Check the public site's content and links before updating the profile or adding a play CTA.

rules: These are proposed brand posts, not financial recommendations or promises.

Keep source SVG artwork unchanged. Cinematic AI promotional interpretations are permitted by the owner; keep recognizable silhouettes and palette, label them as promotional animation when context could imply actual gameplay, and do not claim pixel-identical reproduction.
Mark local development images WIP; distinguish production footage from local or simulated footage.
Do not fabricate users, achievements, partnership announcements, token prices or release dates.
Do not publish internal funding records or private user information.
No automated unsolicited replies, mentions, follows, likes or DMs.
A missing or stale source blocks the relevant factual claim; it does not invite guessing.
No live sale or public demo claim until separately verified.
A user's artwork is featured only with permission and attribution.
Each post needs its required asset before moving from draft to ready.
